title: Shield Breaking
description: Makes it so you can break mob' shields!
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp)](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

This mod makes it so you can break shields that are being held by mobs, by hitting them enough times!

By default shields get broken on the 5th hit, but you can change that with the following command:

**/changeshieldbreaking <Times>**

Now if you have mods that make mobs use shields these cannot be spammed too much, made it mostly to make Improved Mobs less annoying.

If you want to get updates on the mod development, report bugs or suggest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server: [https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG](https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG)
